memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Now the men had said to her, "This oath you made us swear will not be binding on us unless, when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you have brought your father and mother, your brothers and all your family into your house. If any of them go outside your house into the street, their blood will be on their own heads; we will not be responsible. As for anyone who is in the house with you, their blood will be on our head if a hand is laid on them." — Josh 2:17-20 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The spies give Rahab clear conditions. She must tie a scarlet cord in her window, and all her family must be gathered inside her house. Safety would be found in one place only — under the sign of the scarlet cord, within the marked home. Step outside, and the protection no longer covered you.

Christians for centuries have seen in that scarlet cord a beautiful echo of salvation. Rahab and her household were saved by a sign in red, displayed in faith, in a city about to fall under judgment. It calls to mind an earlier night in Egypt, when the blood of the lamb was placed on the doorposts and the destroyer passed over every marked home (Ex 12:13). We must be careful not to invent meaning the text does not carry — the passage does not itself call the cord a symbol of blood. Yet the pattern is unmistakable and deeply biblical: God provides a sign of deliverance, and those who trust it and stay under it are saved.

This all points to Christ, our true Passover Lamb (1 Cor 5:7). His blood is the sign under which we find refuge. And just as Rahab's family had to be inside the house, safety today is found in one place: in Christ. To be "in Him" is to be saved; to remain outside is to be exposed.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Have you come inside the place of safety — into Christ Himself?
2. Rahab had to gather her family under the sign; whom are you drawing toward Christ?
3. How does the scarlet cord deepen your gratitude for Jesus, our Passover Lamb?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, thank You that Your blood is my sure refuge. Keep me hidden in You, and help me bring my loved ones under the same saving grace. Amen.
